desc:
💤 OPEN PACKS, TRADE ANIME CARDS & EARN MONEY WHILE OFFLINE 🤑

👋 Welcome to Trade Anime Cards!

📦 Open card packs, collect graded Anime Cards, and earn cash - even while offline.

👥 Trade with other players at a trading board:
1. Add your cards
2. Both players press ✅ to accept
3. Press ❌ to cancel or ➕ to request more

✨ Find rare Graded & Mutated Cards with huge boosts, buy better packs, and complete the Index!

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates!
